findings.source: @prb/math Common.sol exp2: eight one-armed 'if (x & 0xFF<<k > 0) { 8 one-armed bit tests }' blocks, then result *= UNIT; result >>= 191 - (x >> 64)
findings.issue: The first byte test of exp2 is joined with a phi (_256), but from the second one on the continuation (the remaining bytes, the pow clamp, mul, add, and the whole rest of the function) is copied into both arms of each test, up to 2^7 copies per pow branch; this blow-up is what exhausts the decompiler (previous finding). The arms only assign a value (no effect).
findings.rule: When both arms of a branch reach the same block and differ only in register values, join them at the immediate post-dominator and print the differing values as phis (as already done for the bit tests and the first byte); never duplicate a continuation that contains calls or returns.

notes: The pack has no per-function source (no AST match); reviewed against CDOLens.sol and @prb/math 4.2.3 (pow with the final clamp, log2, exp2, msb, mulDiv18). getAPRs (8,392 lines) and getTrancheAPR (8,369 lines) reviewed by structure: calls (accounting, aprPairFeed, latestRoundData, totalStrategyAssets, totalAssets(nav), riskX/Y/K, reserveBps, getCDOAddress, isJrt), the four trivial pow branches in full (tvlRatio branches, mulDiv18 overflow errors with the right operands, checked add/sub, signed div checks, unsigned max of UD60x18Ext, net-APR factor, isJrt ? jrt : srt, int64 truncations): all faithful. The log2 input checks are correctly omitted (dead: x < 1e18 cannot reach log2), as are the msb tests above 2^32 (dead by range). Loops: addCDOs, removeCDOs, removeCDOInner (inlined in both) and log2 (4 printed copies) are whiles; the 2 implicit address[] decoding loops are rotated whiles (P3). P11: removeCDOInner's underflow/bounds/pop checks under t < length, and push's bound check after length++. P10 counted as the SSA-copy else arms of exp2's bit tests; P12 as the copies of pow's clamp + tail. P8: the scratch mem[0] writes, the zeroed TAPRs struct, unread return-data copies. No execution run (the aborted functions are not checkable by text_check).
summary: The admin and array functions and getPrice are faithful and readable, but the two APR view functions abort: exp2's byte tests are not joined, the tail is duplicated per branch, and the main path loses everything after the risk premium (calls and returns), with the cut paths falling silently off the end; elsewhere memory addresses keep min(n, return_data.size) and PRBMath is expanded into multi-thousand-character lines.
